faq_heading: Homes near Gordon Greenwood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Gordon Greenwood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Gordon Greenwood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Gordon Greenwood Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Gordon Greenwood Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 133 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,327,500, townhomes $867,500, condos $520,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Gordon Greenwood Elementary?
faq.a: Near Gordon Greenwood Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 24 days to sell and closed at 97.4% of the list price, with 8% over asking, across 133 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Gordon Greenwood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Dorothy Peacock Elementary (0.6 km west), Walnut Grove Secondary (0.9 km south-east) and West Langley Elementary (1.3 km north-east).

Gordon Greenwood Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 9175 206 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Gordon Greenwood Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Gordon Greenwood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Gordon Greenwood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Gordon Greenwood Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 133 homes sold within 1 km of Gordon Greenwood Elementary: 54 houses, 42 townhomes and 37 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,327,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Gordon Greenwood Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Gordon Greenwood Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 2 middle, 1 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Dorothy Peacock Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Richard Bulpitt Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Walnut Grove Secondary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Dorothy Peacock Elementary (0.6 km west), West Langley Elementary (1.3 km north-east), James Kennedy Elementary (1.4 km east), Alex Hope Elementary (1.8 km south-east), Topham Elementary (2.0 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Dorothy Peacock Elementary, 0.6 km west of Gordon Greenwood Elementary.
